name: stage-assign
description: Stage·Assign — single-file worship-team stage / mic / setup-checklist tool (Daybreak Church).

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8');const s=h.indexOf('<script>');const e=h.indexOf('</script>');fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/_sa.js',h.slice(s+8,e));require('child_process').execSync('node --check /tmp/_sa.js',{stdio:'inherit'});const css=h.match(/<style>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/)[1];const open=(css.match(/{/g)||[]).length,close=(css.match(/}/g)||[]).length;if(open!==close){console.error('CSS brace mismatch',open,close);process.exit(1)}console.log('JS syntax OK; CSS balanced ('+open+' rules)')"
